title: Development Environment Mapping
description: One workstation's local checkout and toolchain locations. This document is machine-specific and is never committed: it lives at .local/environment.json, and the committed artifacts are this schema and the example beside it. Paths are development defaults, not deployment contracts — production provisioning derives nothing from them. Secrets never appear here; they come from an external secret facility.

checkouts.description: Absolute path to each integration's local checkout. Every property is optional because a given workflow needs only the integrations it drives, but the roster is closed so a misspelled integration fails validation instead of silently going missing.

toolchains.description: Absolute paths to third-party toolchains that are not HoloBike software and therefore have no integration directory under Stack. Only toolchains that must be located by path appear here; tools resolved from PATH (compilers, CMake, Ninja) are validated by preflight rather than declared.

host.description: This workstation's name. Records name their producer, so a release admitted on the panel host can be told from one admitted here.

os.description: Which platform posture this host runs. Product truth lives in Profiles/ and the Stack leaves; this says only what this machine is.

absolutePath.description: An absolute path, POSIX (/srv/...) or Windows (C:\... or C:/...). check normalizes and validates it before any build is invoked.
